criteria.check: Did the response refuse to emit placeholder / TODO / FIXME content inside *.generated.ts files?
Did the response explain that .generated.* files are regenerable artifacts the consumer should never hand-edit — any consumer edits get wiped on the next skmtc generate run?
Did the response identify the right alternatives: either emit complete working output, or don't emit that piece at all and let the consumer wire it up in their own non-generated code?
Did the response avoid going along with the user's framing that 'scaffold a stub, user fills in the rest' is a valid generator shape?
